ref.description: The brand layer entity; the key everywhere. Plain: it is the identity of the kit, not a claim.

name.description: Plain lift source: briefs lift brand.name.value into their client field.

changelog.description: One entry per publish, keyed by "v<version>" (a map, so an entry has an address).

kit.description: The kit's own state, not brand knowledge: host-written, no provenance envelope.

proposition.description: Harvest target: an approved brief offers its single-minded proposition here.

strategy.description: What the brand stands for. Seeded from approved briefs.

tone_words.description: Plain lift source: briefs lift voice.tone_words.value into tone_and_world.

mandatories.description: Plain lift source: briefs lift voice.mandatories.value into mandatories.

pronunciation.description: Keyed by the term, as an id key.

file.description: Arrives only by upload, with its licence. Never taken from a PDF. Absent means no file.

provider.description: Where the font comes from. Named provider, not source, because source is the envelope key for an extracted span.

severity.description: The one value. Brand rules never block (owner, 2026-10-13).

cites.description: The item this rule came from, an address inside the kit.

rules.description: The flat do/dont list agents read; one line each.

channels.description: Keyed by channel id (tv, social, ooh, print).

work.description: Approved exemplars, harvested from client-accepted documents.

materials.$comment: written by the host as material is supplied (the brand book, decks)

projection.$comment: written only by the host, from shared/facts.yaml and shared/sources.yaml

upstream.$comment: written only by the host; kept for the schemas sake

fact_id.description: Opaque fact id. Survives spin-off. Never a path.

projection.description: HOST-WRITTEN, READ-ONLY (decision D2). A scalar projection of shared/facts.yaml and shared/sources.yaml (a Brand Clan has no findings member; the findings keys are tolerated, never required) so view bindings resolve against shared/data.yaml alone. Rebuilt by the host after every change to either member; no agent or human patch may write it; the members are the authority. If built_from does not match the members' hashes the view says so instead of rendering the projection as current.

items.description: Source ids, a human:<id> verification, or — for method: synthesis — the fact ids it rests on

status.description: The layer row's status when pinned. Frozen with the value.

current_value.description: For a stale pin only: the value of the current layer version, offered, never swapped in.

quotes.description: The verbatim passage each cited source gave for this value, by source id. Frozen with the pin.

replaced_by.description: Set when a person resolved a contest over this pin's identity for another value: the pin stays, so every decision citing it still resolves.

sources.description: Every source a pin cites, by id: what it is and where to read it. A frozen copy of shared/sources.yaml.

upstream.description: HOST-WRITTEN, READ-ONLY (docs/contracts/os-layer.md section 5.2). Kept for the schema's sake: a Brand Clan attaches nothing today.

actor.description: An actor as the OS layer writes it: human:<user-id>, process:<job-id> or <producer>/<version>.

decision_id.description: Id of a decision in agent/decision-chain.yaml.

origin.description: extracted: read from supplied material (a brand book page), carries source. proposed: derived from roster or layer pins, carries fact_ids. stated: a person typed it, carries by. confirmed: a person accepted it, carries by.

span.description: Where in the supplied material an extracted value was read.

origin_rules.description: What each origin must carry (campaign-clan.md 2.1, 2.2). Applied to every item and every envelope.

asset.description: An asset of this document, as the host serves it: assets/<name> is human/assets/<name> in the archive.

id_key.description: An entity key: lowercase, digits, - and _. Maps are keyed by it, never positional.
